d:
Two friends attend a party.
Zoey and Gaby are longtime best friends who have been through it all. One night, as they attend a friend's engagement party, Zoey makes a disturbing discovery involving Gaby.
Despite her unease, she helps Gaby try to contain the situation without being discovered by others at the social occasion. But it all might just test the limits of their friendship and their own boundaries with one another.
